# SK0208 — The control-statement braces are not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would add or remove braces under the configured cleanup style.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Syntax |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Brace cleanup rewrites the statement tree rather than whitespace. The rule preserves dangling-else ownership, directives, declarations and formatter-off regions before offering an edit.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
if (ready) { Run(); }
```

Write:

```csharp
if (ready) Run();
```

## When it does not fire

Branches whose braces carry declarations, directives, comments or control-flow meaning are retained.

## Configuration

- `skala_braces_redundant`
